map.plugin.title: Map
map.plugin.summary: The map page, your footprints and map cards in chats, plus place and route lookups (only the one or two spots you ask about go to a map service). It brings no map provider of its own: OpenStreetMap, AMap and Google Maps are each a plugin, the map uses whichever are on, and the map page asks you to turn one on when none is
map.plugin.keep.chat: Places mentioned in chats (that's chat history)
map.plugin.purge.cards: Map cards in chats (their titles, places and routes)
map.card.text: Map card: {title} (open it to see the map)
map.drawing.gone: These places and routes have expired (they're only kept on this computer for a little while and never saved): ask again
map.find.notFound: Couldn't find “{text}” on the map: select something more specific (with the city or district) and try again
map.find.busy: {source} says there have been too many lookups; try again in a while
map.find.unreachable: Can't reach {source}; try again in a while
map.find.key: The {source} key isn't working right now: check Settings · Data sources
map.preview.busy: {name} says it's being used too much; try again later
map.preview.empty: There's nothing on this card to draw
map.preview.noProvider: No map was named to draw it with
map.preview.notConnected: The map “{name}” isn't connected right now
map.proxy.notConnected: This map provider isn't connected (its plugin is off)
